chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya said:
Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) sent me this will along with the other one.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ: An honorific title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him).
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةُ: Will or testament, often referring to a document containing religious instructions or secrets.
key_terms.مَعَ الْأُخْرَىٰ: Along with the other one, indicating multiple documents or instructions were sent together.

ai.seo_question: Who is the sender? Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him). Who is the recipient? Safwan ibn Yahya. What was sent? A will (وصية) along with another one.
ai.summary: Safwan ibn Yahya, a prominent companion and narrator in Shia tradition, received this specific will (wasiyya) directly from Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him), underscoring the continuity of divine guidance through the Imams. In the context of Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this transmission highlights the Imam’s role in preserving essential theological and legal instructions for his followers during the Minor and Major Gheebahs, reinforcing the legitimacy of the Mahdi as the heir to Imam Husain.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 156 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Idris from Muhammad bin Abdul Jabbar from Safwan bin Yahya that he said:
Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s) sent me this will [mentioned above] along another will.
